bots.title: Lark bots
bots.description: Run several custom Lark apps side by side. Each inbound endpoint carries its bot ID, so bindings never cross over.

bots.appSecretDescription: Leave empty on save to keep the encrypted secret you already stored.
bots.defaultModelDescription: Model this bot uses when it opens a new remote session.
bots.autoApproveDescription: Remote messages to this bot bypass the permission gate: any allowed sender can run commands and read or write files directly. Turn it on only when the open_id allowlist is set and you fully trust everyone on it — with an empty allowlist the switch has no effect.

mirror.title: Mirror to Lark
mirror.description: When on, every new desktop run creates a Lark group chat and mirrors the agent output into it. The recipient must be an explicit open_id — Kila no longer guesses "whoever messaged last".

cli.title: Lark CLI ecosystem
cli.description: With the Lark CLI in place, the Kila agent can also reach Lark Docs, Calendar, Mail, Wiki, Base and more. Copy the prompt into a new Kila session and the agent will walk you through the setup.
cli.copyPrompt: Copy the Lark CLI setup prompt
cli.prompt:
Please set up the Lark CLI development environment for me. Follow these steps:

1. Install the Lark CLI globally
npm install -g @larksuite/cli

2. Add the skill to the current Kila workspace
npx skills add https://github.com/larksuite/cli -y -g

3. Initialize the CLI config (this creates a brand-new Lark CLI app, independent of the Kila Lark bot)
lark-cli config init --new

4. Request every domain permission in one pass (Docs / Sheets / Calendar / Tasks / Mail / Contacts / Meetings / Approval / OKR / Wiki / Base / Slides / Attendance / Project and more)
lark-cli auth login --domain all

Step 3 opens an authorization page in the browser — follow the prompts to create the app and scan the QR code to authorize it.
Step 4 opens the browser again — approve all domain permissions at once. Skipping it causes "insufficient permission" errors later when the agent calls Lark Docs, Calendar, Mail and similar services.

wechat.allowedUserIdsDescription: Comma-separated allowlist of WeChat contacts. Leave it empty and every inbound message is rejected.
wechat.maxInboundFileBytesDescription: WeChat attachments above this size are rejected on arrival.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.description: Each account logs in, polls and stores its context credential independently.

login.labelInputDescription: Shown in the account list. Leave it empty to use the account ID returned by iLink.
login.storageNotice: After a successful login the account metadata goes into the local account config, and the bot credential is encrypted into the local credential file.

guide.title: How it works
guide.description: The WeChat remote flow, built on locally encrypted credentials and iLink long polling.
guide.scanBody: Click "Log in by QR code" and scan it with WeChat. Once you are in, the account token is encrypted into the local config directory.
guide.autoConnectBody: When the channel starts it resumes polling for every account in the list. Individual accounts can be started, stopped, re-logged-in or deleted on their own.
guide.messagingBody: Send text, an image or a file over WeChat and Kila binds that contact to a session. Later replies come back to the same session.
guide.approvalBody: WeChat has no interactive approval cards, so Kila sends a text approval code instead — reply as instructed to allow or deny.
